title: [CRY-22] Underspecified parameters in several primitives
description: Review finding CRY-22: Underspecified parameters in several primitives (lens CRY). Location: spec/02-identity.md:211-212, spec/02-identity.md:231, spec/02-identity.md:171, spec/12-security.md:82-83, spec/06-calls.md:215. Fix: All four gaps are present as described. The backup has no salt length or nonce, and its self-describing header (02:231) is not bound as AAD. Share encryption (02:171) names no scheme. The PRF wrap (12:82) gives no salt, HKDF info or IV. The TURN `HMAC(secret, username)` (06:215) names no hash. Fix as proposed. Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
